name: Rowe
source:
"It's OK, little bro won't eat you... probably."

A member of Deeks, he's incredibly loyal to Gilford.
A cheerful innocent seeming guy, but when he's working he goes so cold it's like he's a different person.
Instead of magic guns he uses a sword with so much skill that he's known as the 'Fang of Deeks'.
